# chargebee_item (Resource)

A Chargebee item (Product Catalog 2.0): a plan, addon, or charge. Set name, type, and item_family_id together to create a new item. Omit all three to adopt an existing item by id and track it as-is (every field is read from Chargebee); this is the way to bring an archived item under management with just `id` and `status = "archived"`. If an item with the given id already exists when creating, it is adopted into state and its mutable fields are updated to match this configuration; adoption fails if a create-only field (item_family_id, type, metered, usage_calculation, is_giftable) differs from the existing item. If deletion is refused because the item is in use, it is archived instead (the id stays reserved in Chargebee).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MPL-2.0

resource "chargebee_item" "standard" {
  id             = "standard"
  item_family_id = chargebee_item_family.main.id
  type           = "plan"
  name           = "Standard"
}

resource "chargebee_item" "api_calls" {
  id                = "api-calls"
  item_family_id    = chargebee_item_family.main.id
  type              = "addon"
  name              = "API calls"
  metered           = true
  usage_calculation = "sum_of_usages"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the item. Changing this forces a new resource.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the item.
- `enabled_for_checkout` (Boolean) Whether the item can be purchased via hosted checkout pages (Chargebee defaults to true).
- `enabled_in_portal` (Boolean) Whether the item is visible in the customer portal (Chargebee defaults to true).
- `external_name` (String) Customer-facing name shown on invoices and checkout (Chargebee defaults it to the item name).
- `is_giftable` (Boolean) Whether the item can be gifted. Chargebee defaults this to false. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `is_shippable` (Boolean) Whether orders are created for this item (shippable products).
- `item_family_id` (String) Id of the product family this item belongs to. Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `name` and `type` to create a new item. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Arbitrary string key/value metadata stored on the item.
- `metered` (Boolean) Whether usage for this item is metered (billed in arrears). Chargebee defaults this to false. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `name` (String) Display name of the item. Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `type` and `item_family_id` to create a new item.
- `redirect_url` (String) URL to redirect to after checkout.
- `status` (String) Status of the item in Chargebee: `active` or `archived`. Defaults to the item's current status in Chargebee; set `archived` to archive the item under Terraform management.
- `type` (String) Item type: `plan`, `addon`, or `charge`. Read from Chargebee when omitted; must be set together with `name` and `item_family_id` to create a new item. Changing this forces a new resource.
- `unit` (String) Display unit for quantities (e.g. `seat`, `GB`).
- `usage_calculation` (String) How usage is aggregated for metered items: `sum_of_usages`, `last_usage`, or `max_usage`. Requires `metered = true`. Changing this forces a new resource.
